subject: Recap + urgent decision requested: deployment mode after today's incident
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jennings <alice.jennings@edgepayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + urgent decision requested: deployment mode after today's incident

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and ask so we have a single place to action.

What you shared (brief):
- Between 08:10–08:45 PT you saw repeated 5xx + timeouts on the Hosted API path; root cause appears to be request concurrency spike tied to a batch job that misfired.
- Impact: ~30 minutes of degraded responses, multiple customer-facing errors; 99th percentile p99 latencies jumped from ~110ms to >1.2s.
- Your team is running a low-latency payments routing workload (avg gen length ~180 tokens) and corrects must be in place before next release on Friday.

Decision context we discussed:
- Short-term mitigation: provision a dedicated capacity pool (reserved) to give immediate isolation and stable throughput.
- Medium-term: evaluate Private VPC deployment if you need network isolation + customer-managed KMS and longer retention controls.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm target SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and steady-state RPS you want us to size for. If you can share a 1-hour peak sample CSV, attach to reply.
2) Do you want Redwood to stand up a Dedicated pilot (48–72 hour turnaround) or start a Private VPC intake (2–3 week cycle including security review)?
3) If Dedicated pilot is OK, we will spin a reserved pool sized to your 99th percentile throughputs and schedule a cutover window with ops.

I attached a short CSV with the call logs extract and a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP). Once you confirm which path (Dedicated pilot vs Private intake) we will lock timelines and cost estimates.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: call-logs-summary-0705.csv, MAP_edgepayments_v1.xlsx
From: Alice Jennings <alice.jennings@edgepayments.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgePayments Ops <ops@edgepayments.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + urgent decision requested: deployment mode after today's incident

Sofia — appreciate the recap and the clear options. Confirming the incident timeline is accurate. A few clarifications and our ask: 

- During the 30m window our internal telemetry shows error rates peaking at 12% for inference requests; p99 latency hit ~1.25s. We rely on <150ms p95 for our main user flow.
- We need a mitigation that is in effect before Friday's release (72 hours).

EdgePayments preference: immediate Dedicated pilot. We cannot commit to a Private VPC in that window (security intake will take longer). Please send a scope + cost for the Dedicated pilot and any assumptions about burst capacity and cache warming.

Also sending a short sample (attached) of the 60min peak window. For the pilot, we expect Redwood to own the capacity sizing and provide an ops contact for the cutover.

Alice Jennings
Head of Platform Engineering, EdgePayments
alice.jennings@edgepayments.com | +1 617-555-0133

Attachment: edgepayments_peak_sample_0705.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Jennings <alice.jennings@edgepayments.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + urgent decision requested: deployment mode after today's incident

Looping in Karthik for contractual/discount guidance and making this explicit from the AE side:

Marissa (AE) here — EdgePayments has asked for a Dedicated pilot with a 48–72 hour target to have mitigation in place before Friday. Questions for the thread:
- Karthik: can we push a short-term pilot pricing (1 week minimal commitment) and an emergency SLA addendum for the pilot window? If so please advise what flexibility we have on an emergency reserve.
- Aditya: can you confirm the minimal GPU footprint to handle the attached 60min peak sample and any suggested cache/prefix warm strategies?

Proposed MAP (short):
1) Today by EOD: Redwood confirms Dedicated pilot cost and target footprint + ops contact.
2) Tomorrow: Redwood provisions reserved pool and schedules a morning cutover test with EdgePayments (2–3 hour window).
3) Friday: observe release under Dedicated pilot; decision to either keep Dedicated for steady-state or start Private intake.

Alice — is that timeline workable? If yes, we'll produce a one-page pilot quote and an ops runbook.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Jennings <alice.jennings@edgepayments.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + urgent decision requested: deployment mode after today's incident

Thanks — quick technical confirmation and runbook pointers.

Sizing/technical notes (based on the sample):
- Suggested minimal dedicated pool: 4 x A10G-equivalent GPUs with continuous batching enabled, KV cache warmed for the top 5 prefixes. This handles steady-state + 2x observed peak headroom.
- Estimated warm-up: ~30–45 minutes to populate prefix cache for common routes; we recommend a staged traffic ramp during the cutover window.
- Cutover plan (48–72h ready):
   1) Provision reserved pool (Ops trigger) — ~2 hours to stand up containers and load model artifacts.
   2) Validate perf with synthetic traffic (30m).
   3) Staged traffic switch (traffic shadowing -> 10%->50%->100%) over 60–90m.

I uploaded a one-page dedicated pilot runbook to our internal runbooks and attached a pdf stub for reference. I'll be available for the cutover and will join the ops channel.

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: dedicated-pilot-runbook.pdf
